main_text.p: Nemo certè propenfiori quam ego ftudio, in debitas omnes Reformationes ferc-tur, maturo modò judicio, & confcientiâ bonâ fufcipiantur, atque in ea folum procedant, quæ æqua priùs deliberatione habita ). ex Dei Verbo,& Recta Ratione evincentur pravè admiffa; Hic vero plus ultrò exhibui,quàm vel ea, quæ liberrima, pleniffima, prudentiffima erant Parlamenta, unquam adhùc expetebant.

Nimis clarè vero conftat ex iis quæ infequuta funt, Reformationis hujus Consilium nihil aliud fuiffe, quam ut dejecto de gradu Episcopatu, & in Presbyteratum commutato, fundis suis & reditibus spoliaretur Dei Ecclesia. Nulli enim hactenus magis in Legitimo suo Jure violati fue-runt quam Episcopi, cæterique Ecclesiastici. Hi statim ut pinguissimæ ferarum, mactan-di: Reliquus Schismatum & Hæresium ma-cer Grex tolerari haud ægrè impetrabit. Sic ob vineam suam Naboth reus factus Blas-phemiæ. Ita usque perspicio, utcunque vela impleverit Religionis Spiritus, Utilitatem solam esse Circinum, quo cursum suum Factiosi homines in seditiosis hisce Motibus guber-nant.

page.notes: Reading "dejecto" at the start of the second paragraph is doubtful: the scan shows a long-s-like letter, so it is marked [?] in the text. The "s" of "de,ecto" was read as j. Only the text printed on this part is transcribed. The first word of the lower paragraph, "Provcn-tus", is hard to read; the letters "Provcn" are uncertain and may be a printing error for "Proventus". The printed "Hæresium" and "Utilitatem" are copied as printed, with the u/v spelling corrected.
